name: Reycho
source:
The unofficial leader of the Go-Getters Club. No matter the problem, Reycho thinks hard about how it can be solved and will never give up. He's known for his physical ability, but occasionally runs into situations headfirst. He's childish in both good ways and bad, completely devoid of negativity, embodying the pure innocence of a child. However, he's completely oblivious to girls.

[From official site]

[spoiler]Reycho is actually a remote-controlled robot operated by Pochi, making Pochi the true protagonist of [i]World's End Club[/i].[/spoiler]
